name: Pimoroni Pico Plus 2
description: Pico-shaped RP2350B board with 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, USB-C, Qw/ST and SP/CE connectors and labelled pins; a drop-in Pico 2 upgrade for memory-hungry projects.
notes: Same 40-pin Pico footprint and pinout (GP0-22, GP26-28 plus ADC pins via 1 kOhm to GP40-42); SP/CE connector adds GP32-GP36; Qw/ST uses GP4/GP5.
RP2350B (QFN-80) with 8 MB PSRAM (CS on GP47); BOOT button on GP45 is usable as a user input; VSYS sense on GP43.
Stock uses RP2350 A2 silicon with erratum E9 - add external pull-downs of 8.2 kOhm or less for inputs pulled low.
A WiFi/BLE variant, Pico Plus 2 W, adds a Raspberry Pi RM2 radio. Often out of stock.
